material.acceptance_criteria: a CI reload that changes the kind at a handled index drops the handle and logs one ev=mod_unit_refused reason=kind_changed at reload time; the job asserts both.
material.description: keep_handles keeps a handle whenever a unit is alive at its index, even if a different kind now sits there. A handle whose kind is absent from the new catalog is dropped with no log line, and only the next order reports it.
material.resolution: Landed and witnessed on the green tip 7f32d350e1b036477ba59d97bded99138f01685e: a mod handle is dropped and logged reason=kind_changed when its kind changes.
material.subject: Keep a handle only when its kind is unchanged, and log a dropped handle
